title: How Do You Check That a Boat Tour Operator in Madeira Is Licensed?
description: Ask the operator for its RNAAT number and look it up in Visit Madeira's directory of tourist animation companies, then check insurance, skipper and red flags.
heroAlt: A skipper seen from behind at the helm, steering a boat out past the Funchal harbour wall
keywords: how to check a boat tour operator in Madeira is licensed
is my Madeira boat tour legal
